edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient and per-caller presale accounting key inside mintTTG.
changeNameAndDescription authorises the call by comparing _msgSender() with the token owner.
onlyOwner compares the stored owner with _msgSender(), so caller identity drives access control.
Presale quota in _authorised is keyed by msg.sender and decremented during minting.
_presale counters are indexed by msg.sender during the presale phase.
mintTTG reads MAX_PURCHASE to bound the per-transaction amount.
mintTTG checks totalSupply().add(amountOfTTGs) against MAX_TTG.
mintTTG skips the reserved range using AMOUNT_RESERVED when advancing _nextTokenId.
mintTTG enforces the presale supply cap using AMOUNT_PRESALE.
mintTTG validates public mint payment with TTG_PRICE.
mintTTG validates presale payment with TTG_PRE_PRICE.
mintTTG reads and decrements the caller's _authorised presale quota.
mintTTG increments the caller's _presale counter.
mintTTG branches on the _state sale phase (PreParty versus Party).
mintTTG accumulates the presale minted count in _preSaleSuply.
mintTTG reads and advances _nextTokenId for every minted token.
mintTTG skips the token range before _startingIndex.
mintTTG calls _safeMint inside its minting loop.
mintTTG is protected by the nonReentrant modifier, gating reentrant entry.
mintTTG performs price multiplication used for payment validation.
_safeMint calls _mint to create the token before the receiver check.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received after minting.
_safeMint path reaches the onERC721Received callback on an arbitrary recipient contract.
_checkOnERC721Received invokes IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received, handing control to the recipient.
setStartingIndexAndMintReserve derives and writes _startingIndex from blockhash.
setStartingIndexAndMintReserve uses MAX_TTG for the index modulo and clamping.
setStartingIndexAndMintReserve mints AMOUNT_RESERVED tokens starting from _startingIndex.
setStartingIndexAndMintReserve loops calling _safeMint for the reserved batch.
setStartingIndexAndMintReserve is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner.
setStartingIndexAndMintReserve increments _startingIndex with SafeMath add.
changeNameAndDescription reads and sets the _nameChanged flag for the token.
changeNameAndDescription requires payment equal to RENAME_PRICE after the free first change.
withdrawAllEth is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner.
withdrawAllEth transfers the whole balance through the sendValue library helper.
sendValue performs a low-level call{value} that forwards all gas to the payee.
withdrawAllEth performs an external ETH transfer to an arbitrary owner-chosen payee.
authoriseTTG writes presale quota into _authorised.
authoriseTTG is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner.
authoriseTTG increases _authorised[human] using unchecked-eligible addition.
authoriseTTGBatch loops calling authoriseTTG for each address.
authoriseTTGBatch is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner.
setTTGPrice writes the public mint price into TTG_PRICE.
setTTGPrice is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner.
setMaxTTGs writes the supply cap into MAX_TTG.
setMaxTTGs is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner.
startPreParty reads and transitions the _state sale phase.
startPreParty is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner.
onlyOwner resolves the current owner through the _owner storage slot.
reserveAddress is the mint recipient passed to _safeMint inside the reserve loop.
amountOfTTGsMint controls the number of tokens minted and the payment required.
tokenIdRename selects the token whose ownership is checked and metadata updated.
newName is emitted in the NameAndDescriptionChanged event.
newDescription is emitted in the NameAndDescriptionChanged event.
payee is the destination of the full-balance transfer.
human is the address whose _authorised quota is increased.
amountOfTTGsAuth is the quota amount added to _authorised[human].
humans is iterated to grant quota in batch.
amountOfTTGsBatch is granted to every address in the batch loop.
amountAmount is written into the MAX_TTG supply cap by setMaxTTGs.
priceParam is written into TTG_PRICE by setTTGPrice.
firstTTGRecieved records the first minted id and is returned as the mint result.
amountPaid holds msg.value used for rename fee validation.
ownerLocal holds the token owner used for the caller authorisation check.
loopIndexI drives the minting loop that issues amountOfTTGs tokens.

normalization_plan.reason: reserveAddress is only meaningful as the recipient argument of setStartingIndexAndMintReserve's minting loop.
amountOfTTGsMint is the quantity parameter of mintTTG and has no independent behaviour.
tokenIdRename is the token selector parameter of changeNameAndDescription.
newName is only consumed by the changeNameAndDescription event emission.
newDescription is only consumed by the changeNameAndDescription event emission.
payee is the transfer destination parameter of withdrawAllEth.
human is the target address parameter of authoriseTTG.
amountOfTTGsAuth is the quota parameter of authoriseTTG.
humans is the batch input array parameter of authoriseTTGBatch.
amountOfTTGsBatch is the quota parameter applied in the authoriseTTGBatch loop.
amountAmount is the value parameter assigned to MAX_TTG by setMaxTTGs.
priceParam is the value parameter assigned to TTG_PRICE by setTTGPrice.
firstTTGRecieved is a transient local of mintTTG used only for the return value and event.
amountPaid is a transient local of changeNameAndDescription holding msg.value.
ownerLocal is a transient local of changeNameAndDescription used for the owner check.
loopIndexI is the transient loop counter of mintTTG's minting loop.
